description: The BI Book Table Writeback visual enhances Power BI reporting by enabling users to input, edit, and update data directly within the platform. It streamlines collaboration by allowing team members to update figures in a single view and create additional dimensions of their data without altering the main dataset. This visual provides its users with accuracy through real-time updates and efficiency by simplifying processes. Activation of BI Book Table Writeback requires an existing BI Book environment. Monthly fees apply for the use of BI Book Table Writeback. For more information please visit https://get.bibook.com/pricing
